headline: Zane's Best Cards
title: Zane's Best Cards in Yu-Gi-Oh | Top 3 Explained
video_script: Here are Zane Truesdale's Cyber Dragons. Number 3: Cyber Dragon, a free Special Summon when only your opponent has a monster. Number 2: Cyber Twin Dragon, two Cyber Dragons fused, attacking twice per Battle Phase. Number 1: and Cyber End Dragon, three Cyber Dragons fused into four thousand attack with piercing damage. Whose deck should I cover next? Comment below!
